title: Track LR Online & Check Shipment Status | Vidhi Transport
description: Track a Vidhi Transport LR online to view its route, booking date, latest ERP status update and estimated delivery, with direct customer-care support.

hero.title: Track with your LR number.
intro: Enter the numeric lorry receipt number to request its latest record from the Vidhi Transport ERP.

sections.title: Keep the transport reference close.
intro: Your LR number is the fastest way for a branch or customer-care team to identify the consignment.

cards.title: Locate the LR
body: Check the lorry receipt issued for the shipment.

cards.title: Enter it exactly
body: Use only the numeric LR reference shown on the receipt.

cards.title: Contact support
body: Keep the LR number ready if the live service cannot answer your request.

faqs.q: Where can I find the LR number?
faqs.a: The LR or lorry receipt number appears on the transport receipt issued for the consignment. Enter only the numeric LR number printed on that receipt.

faqs.q: What information does online LR tracking show?
faqs.a: When a matching record is available, the page shows the LR number, route, booking date, consignment status, last status update and estimated delivery date returned by Vidhi Transport's tracking service.

faqs.q: What do the LR tracking statuses mean?
faqs.a: Booked means the consignment has been registered, On the way means it is moving through the transport network, and Delivered means the ERP record marks the consignment as delivered.

faqs.q: What should I do if live tracking is unavailable?
faqs.a: Retry after checking the LR number. If the service still cannot be reached, contact customer care by phone, WhatsApp or email and include the LR number.

faqs.q: What should I share for a delivery issue?
faqs.a: Share the LR number, consignor and consignee, destination, issue description and an authorised contact number. Avoid posting invoices or confidential documents in public channels.
